name: Creamy Parmesan Turkey Sauté with Spinach, Tomato & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 (142 g) pkgs baby spinach
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic; peel, halve, and mince onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until almost cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg ground turkey
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the turkey is almost cooked through, add tomatoes and spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until turkey is cooked through and tomatoes are softened, 5-6 minutes more.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a medium bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan and stir to combine.

Add half of the Parmesan-basil mixture to the pot, along with the cream (reserving the rest for serving). Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide sauté between plates or bowls, then top with reserved Parmesan and basil. Enjoy!
